messages:
Maria D.: Hey folks — quick design review request. Prototype for the playground structured-output panel + run history attached. Main goals: make function/schema defs discoverable during runs, keep run history compact, and fix a11y tab/focus issues. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/proto1.png

AJ: Nice, saw the screenshot. Main nit: run history rows feel long. Can we collapse to one line with a chevron to expand? e.g.
```
[▸] 2026-03-18 11:23 — CreateInvoice (success) — 1.6s
```
When expanded show full schema diffs and tool call args. Keeps scanability.

Samir: +1 on collapse. Also copy tweak: instead of "Function defs" use "Tool definitions" everywhere — less jargon for product folks.

Lee: Accessibility notes: keyboard focus needs to land on the chevron when a row is tabbable. Streaming output should use `aria-live="polite"` only for the new tokens area; metadata updates (status, duration) should not trigger screenreader spam. Also color contrast: status chips (green/yellow/red) are < 4.5:1 on the current BG.

Maria D.: Good catches. For the schema editor inline help, I want a tiny help icon that opens a modal with examples. Thoughts on an inline sample vs full modal?

AJ: Inline sample ok for simple cases. Modal for complex function signatures and JSON Schema examples. We can store the example snippets per-model and surface the 1-liners inline.

Samir: UX copy for the modal header: "Tool definition examples" -> "Tool examples & schema". Make the call-to-action button say "Insert example" not just "Apply". More explicit.

Lee: Keyboard shortcut request: `k` to focus the run history search, `/` to jump to playground prompt. We'll need to surface the shortcuts in a11y help. Also add visible focus ring — don't rely on color only.

AJ: Implementation note: for collapsed rows we can precompute a summary line server-side: model name + function count + top-level keys present. That'll avoid DOM bloat when someone has thousands of runs.

DesignBot: Accessibility scan results (auto): 3 critical issues: low contrast on status chips, missing aria-live on streaming area, missing label on insert-example button. See auto report: https://ci.redwood.dev/a11y/1867123456

Maria D.: Action items:
- AJ: prototype collapsed row + expand details (due Fri)
- Lee: add aria-live + focus ring PR (due Thu)
- Samir: update copy variants for modal and toolbar (small PR)
- Maria: wire up example snippets API and share demo link when ready

AJ: I'll post a short walkthrough recording when the prototype lands. Quick Q: should expanded diff show raw JSON by default or a pretty schema view?

Samir: Pretty schema view by default, with a "View raw" toggle. Non-technical users like the simplified view.

Lee: For screenreaders, ensure raw view has `role="region" aria-label="Raw schema"` and pretty view has exposed headings per field.

Maria D.: All right thanks team. Will sync in design review on Mon 9am. :thumbsup:
